cells.notes: Constant emission (0.25, 0.5, 0.75). Proves the linear float path end to end on both sides: any hidden sRGB encode, tone map, or view transform shifts every value.
Emission = (u, v, 0). Proves UV origin, orientation, and readback row order agree; the documented MaterialX/three 'upside down' UV trap inverts the green channel here.

R = GREATER_THAN(u, 0.5), G = LESS_THAN(v, 0.5). The documented mx_ifgreater/mx_ifequal inversion class: an inverted comparison flips half the texels, far outside tolerance. Texel centers never sit exactly on 0.5 at this size.
Blender Mapping (POINT): scale (2,1), Z rotation 30deg over UV, visualized as biased coordinates 0.25*p + 0.5 so the range stays bakeable. Wrong operation order or rotation sign produces gross error.

cells.failureClass: corpus-priority node (110 uses in the splash audit)
cells.notes: Two-stop LINEAR ColorRamp over u: position 0.2 -> (0.1, 0.2, 0.8), position 0.8 -> (0.9, 0.5, 0.1). Exact linear remap + mix; interpolation-mode sweeps come later.

a = 4u-2 divided by a three-band divisor floor(3v)-1 in {-1, 0, 1}. Cycles' safe_divide returns 0 on the zero band; raw GPU division returns inf/NaN. The TSL mapping must carry Blender's guard, and this cell proves it. Output biased 0.25x+0.5 and clamped on both sides.

MODULO(8u-4, 1.5). Blender uses C fmod (truncated, sign of the dividend); GLSL mod is floored (sign of the divisor) — fmod(-3.1, 1.5) = -0.1 versus 1.4. The TSL mapping must emit truncated modulo. Output biased 0.25x+0.5.

POWER(4u-2, 2.0). GLSL pow with a negative base is undefined (NaN on most drivers); Blender's compatible pow gives pow(|x|, y) with the sign of an odd integer exponent. The TSL mapping must carry Blender's convention. Output scaled 0.2x and clamped.
R = 0.5+0.5*sin(8u), G = 0.5+0.5*cos(8v). GPU sin/cos versus Cycles' — proves transcendental agreement stays inside channel tolerance.
Three-stop CONSTANT ramp over u (stops at 0.0, 0.3, 0.6). Constant interpolation takes the left stop's color; texel centers never sit exactly on a stop at this size.

Blender Mapping TEXTURE mode with scale (2,1), Z rotation 30deg: the INVERSE of POINT — inverse-rotate first, then divide by scale. Wrong inversion order is the documented place2d class. Output biased 0.25x+0.5.

cells.failureClass: disagreeing noise implementations (fBM composition, now ported)
cells.notes: Blender Noise detail 2, roughness 0.5 through the PORTED Cycles fractal loop (blenderNoiseFac: i <= floor(detail) octaves over the shared base octave, amplitude-sum normalization, fractional-detail blend). MaterialX's own fBM measured 4.6e-2 divergence; the port must close it.

cells.failureClass: Mix node blend modes (MIX / MULTIPLY / ADD)
cells.notes: Three RGBA Mix nodes with varying factors feed one channel each: R = MIX(u), G = MULTIPLY(v), B = ADD(u). Blender blends toward the operator result by the factor: mix(a, op(a, b), fac).

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Mix DIVIDE x9) + zero-divisor semantics
cells.notes: RGBA Mix DIVIDE with B = (0.5, 0, 2): the green channel divides by zero, and the reference decides Blender's fallback empirically. The mapping keeps A untouched on the zero band.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Map Range SMOOTHSTEP x8)
cells.notes: Smoothstep interpolation applies the cubic ease to the clamped safe-divide factor before the target remap.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Map Range SMOOTHERSTEP x27 — the whole ellie denim class)
cells.notes: Quintic smootherstep t^3(t(6t-15)+10) applied to the clamped safe-divide factor — one interpolation enum blocks all 27 paint-stroke mix factors in ellie.
Three-stop B-Spline colorband via the sampled-LUT route: Blender's own evaluate() fills 257 texels and the shader lerps between exact samples — no reimplementation of the spline basis to drift.
Cardinal interpolation through the same sampled-LUT route as B-Spline.
Blender's 2D noise dimension against mx_noise_float's vec2 overload — a different Perlin dimension than 3D-at-z=0, measured rather than assumed to share the lineage.

Detail 0, scale 11, W driven from UV.y. three has NO 1D Perlin - mx_perlin_noise_float is an overloadingFn over vec2 and vec3 only - so this is a direct port of Blender's perlin_1d, grad1 and hash_uint from intern/cycles/kernel/svm/noise.h with noise_scale1's 0.25 folded in. Detail 0 isolates the single octave so a gradient or hash error cannot hide inside the fBM accumulation. The port's .toVar() calls are load-bearing: hashUint1's all-literal seeds const-fold in WGSL, and a const-expression that overflows u32 is a compile ERROR, not a wrap - the first attempt shipped an uncompilable shader and measured stale pixels at 1.79e-1. run-debug1d.mjs is the bisection rig that found it.

cells.failureClass: Blender perlin_1d through the fBM loop
cells.notes: Detail 2, scale 6, W driven from UV.x - 9 of ellie's 49 visible materials use 1D noise. Pairs with noise-1d-detail0: this one adds the octave loop on top of the octave that cell already pins. hash_uint is the 1-ARGUMENT member of the Jenkins family and its seed encodes the arity as 0xdeadbeef + (1 << 2) + 13, so it is not hashUint2(x, 0) and substituting one for the other silently yields a different field.

Colour output with Distortion 0.7 on 1D noise: one scalar distortion lane at seed 0, colour lanes at seeds 1 and 2. Guards the lane-count rule -- the old '2 if 2D else 3' fallthrough emitted three vec3 offsets for a scalar field, the same silent-else family as the dimensions bug that sent 1D through mx_noise_float.

cells.failureClass: Blender perlin_4d through the fBM loop
cells.notes: 4D Fac, Vector from UV, constant W 3.3, scale 5, detail 2 -- the watch-family shape; 7 of ellie's 49 visible materials use 4D noise. grad4 and quad_mix ported verbatim from intern/cycles/kernel/svm/noise.h with noise_scale4's 0.8344 folded in; hashUint4 was already proven by the white-noise 4D path, and unlike hashUint1 it has no const-fold trap because every operand mixes in a runtime key.

Colour output AND Distortion 0.5 together on 4D: four distortion lanes at seeds 0..3, colour lanes at seeds 4 and 5. Fails if either family gets the wrong seeds or arity. This is the exact configuration ellie's watch materials author (scale 19.7, detail 4, distortion 0.5, Color).
A corner color attribute linear in UV (exact under any triangulation) sampled by Vertex Color, against three's 'color' geometry attribute — the COLOR_0 contract the glTF path ships.

cells.failureClass: node-group wall crossing (the dominant scene refusal)
cells.notes: Outer UV feeds a group instance whose inside runs Noise; the emitter must cross the group wall in both directions with the instance context. Scene coverage measured group-wrapped surfaces as the single largest refusal class.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Map Range x8 across scenes)
cells.notes: LINEAR float Map Range 0.2..0.8 -> 0.1..0.9 with clamp: safe-divide factor, then result clamped to the ordered target range.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Mix OVERLAY x4 across scenes)
cells.notes: Cycles folds the factor into the per-channel overlay formula (a < 0.5 branches) rather than lerping the result; the cell proves the folded form.
PINGPONG(4u, 0.75): |fract((a-b)/(2b)) * 2b - b| with the b = 0 guard.
Clamp node in Min Max mode over 2u-0.5: min(max(value, 0.1), 0.9).
safe_sqrt over 4u-2: the left half exercises the negative-input -> 0 guard; raw GPU sqrt returns NaN there.
inversesqrt(a) for a > 0, else 0. The nearest positive texel value (1/32) bounds the pole; dyadic texel inputs are float-exact on both engines.
exp over (-2, 2), scaled 0.125 into range.
safe_log: a <= 0 -> 0 (the left half), else log(a)/log(base) with base swept 2..4. The base ~= 1 divisor-zero branch is covered by the safe-divide cell.
ceil over (-2, 2); dyadic texel centers never land on integer boundaries.
fract over (-1, 2): the negative stretch proves x - floor(x), not truncation.
trunc over (-2, 2): rounds toward zero, so the negative side differs from floor by one.
Blender rounds half away from zero; WGSL's native round is half-to-even, so the mapping uses sign(x)*floor(|x|+0.5). Texel centers never sit on half-integers at this size.
floor(safe_divide(a, b)) * b with the increment swept 0.26..0.76; the non-dyadic offset keeps step boundaries off exact float values.
wrapf(value, max, min): range = max - min, value - range*floor((value-min)/range). Min swept 0.01..0.31 under a fixed max of 0.8; output lands in [min, max).

Cycles: |a - b| <= max(epsilon, 1e-5) ? 1 : 0 — the epsilon floor is part of the semantics. A wedge that widens with v. Measured: a slope of exactly 0.2 puts 13 texel rows (2j+1 divisible by 5, where 0.2*5/128 = 1/128) on exact float knife edges that interpolation ulps flip per engine; the 0.19/0.013 spec keeps every boundary off representable coincidences.
smoothminf: h = max(k - |a-b|, 0)/k; min(a,b) - h^3*k/6 with k = 0.5.
-smoothminf(-a, -b, k) with k = 0.5.
sign over (-2, 2); texel centers never hit exactly zero.
tan over (-1.4, 1.4), inside the poles at +-pi/2; |tan| <= 5.8 scaled 0.08 into range.
Input swept (-1.5, 1.5): Cycles clamps to [-1, 1] before asin, so the overshoot proves the domain clamp instead of NaN.
Same clamped domain as arcsine; acos lands in [0, pi], scaled 0.25.
atan over (-4, 4).
atan2(y = 2u-1, x = 2v-1) covers all four quadrants; y never hits exactly zero at texel centers, so the branch cut stays off the grid.
sinh over (-2, 2).
cosh over (-2, 2).
tanh over (-3, 3).
degrees -> radians over (-180, 180).
radians -> degrees over (-3, 3), scaled 1/400 into range.
The floored twin of math-modulo-sign: a - floor(a/b)*b keeps the divisor's sign, so the negative stretch lands in [0, 1.5) instead of (-1.5, 0].
R = SUBTRACT.G (interp toward a-b), G = SCREEN.R (1 - (tm + t(1-b))(1-a)), B = DIFFERENCE.R (interp toward |a-b|). Channels chosen so every output stays in the bakeable range.

DARKEN interps toward min(a,b); LIGHTEN interps toward max(a,b) — MEASURED: the legacy compositor's asymmetric max(a, b*t) form diverged mean 2.6e-2 / max 0.155 with the kink at t = a/b, so Cycles' Mix uses the symmetric interp; EXCLUSION is max(interp toward a+b-2ab, 0).

DODGE with an HDR B channel (1.4) so t*b crosses 1 and the divisor-collapse -> 1 branch is exercised along with the min clamp; BURN's 1-(1-a)/tmp crosses its lower clamp as v -> 1; SOFT_LIGHT is the branchless screen-weighted form.
a + t*(2b - 1) across all three channels of one node; the default A/B constants keep every channel inside the bakeable range for the whole factor sweep.

cells.failureClass: Mix blend-mode sweep (HSV family, rgb<->hsv port)
cells.notes: HUE grafts B's hue (0.896, sextant 5) onto A's S/V and lerps; SATURATION lerps A's saturation toward B's inside A's hue (0.389, sextant 2). Both run the ported Cycles rgb_to_hsv / hsv_to_rgb round trip on constants, so branch decisions are stable. The B-saturation-zero gate branch stays constant-A and is covered by construction.

cells.failureClass: Mix blend-mode sweep (HSV family, rgb<->hsv port)
cells.notes: VALUE lerps A's V toward B's (ungated in Cycles); COLOR grafts B's hue AND saturation over A's value with the same saturation gate as HUE.
Componentwise subtract, a swept safe divide, and a constant-zero divisor lane that must return 0 (the whole channel sits at the post offset).
Dot product through the scalar Value output (the emitter marks these scalar), a cross-product component, and the componentwise multiply the corpus uses (x4 in cube-diorama).
Length and distance through the Value output; normalize's X component with a constant z of 0.5 keeping the length bounded away from the safe_normalize zero branch.
Componentwise min against a falling ramp, max against a rising one (both kink mid-tile), and abs over a sign-crossing sweep.
Floor, ceil, and fraction (x - floor(x)) over sign-crossing sweeps; dyadic texel centers never land on integer boundaries.
The vector twins of the proven scalar modulo/snap/wrap semantics, built per channel because a vector-condition select collapses to one lane.
Componentwise sin/cos/tan; tan stays inside the poles at +-pi/2.
The whole a*b + c vector feeds the channel directly, proving the implicit vector -> color conversion path as well.

cells.failureClass: corpus-priority node (RGB Curves x11 across scenes)
cells.notes: RGB Curves via the sampled-LUT route Cycles itself uses: a bent composite C curve composed before distinct R/G/B channel curves (wrong order is gross error), per-channel input gradients, and the Fac lerp swept over v. Tolerance is the LUT-reconstruction class shared with the spline colorramps.
Scale-4 checker over UV with two constant colors: epsilon-nudged floor parity in all three axes ((xi%2 == yi%2) == zi%2). Dyadic texel centers never land on cell boundaries.

R = LINEAR over u, G = QUADRATIC over 2u-1 (crosses the max(x,0) guard), B = RADIAL around the tile center (all four atan2 quadrants; the branch cut at v = 0.5 stays off texel centers). Cycles saturates the output.
Depth 2 (default), scale 3, distortion 1.2: the fixed sin/cos cascade with the final 2*distortion shrink. Chained transcendentals share the trig tolerance class.

R = BANDS/X/SIN over UV, G = RINGS/SPHERICAL/SAW around the center, B = BANDS/DIAGONAL/TRI with distortion 1 detail 2 through the ported fractal (the raw [-1,1] fBM recovered as 2*fac - 1). Saw/tri discontinuities land off texel centers.

R = Invert with a swept factor; G = Gamma with the exponent swept 0.5..2.5 (positive components only — Cycles passes zero/negative through); B = Bright/Contrast crossing its zero clamp (a = 1+contrast, b = bright - contrast/2).

R = RGB-to-BW (Rec.709 luminance) over a 2D gradient; G = Separate Color HSV saturation with a moving max channel; B = Combine Color HSV with the hue swept 0..1 — every hsv_to_rgb sextant crosses this row (the sextant switch is continuous, so boundaries carry no knife edges).
Hue shifted a full circle over v (fract(h + hue + 0.5) wraps), saturation scaled 1.3 into its clamp, value 0.9, factor 0.8 — the complete Cycles pipeline over the ported conversions.

White Noise COLOR of the constant (2, 3, 0) — lanes (0.9638, 0.2377, 0.6632) pin the GPU hash3 AND hash4/jenkinsMix paths against CPU-verified ground truth, independent of any coordinate interpolation.
Randomness-0 Voronoi F1 distance is pure lattice geometry — the control that separates a wrong hash from a wrong cell construction (it localized the 5.x signed-PCG finding).

Object texture coordinates are the object-space shading position (measured on the tile proxy: the raw quad coordinates), mapping to three's positionGeometry. Biased 0.25p + 0.5 into range. Unlocks the splash DPM class (x21).

Generated = (p - texspace_location) / (2 * texspace_size) + 0.5, measured on the proxy (which reports size (1,1,1); the degenerate z axis reads 0.5). The runtime contract supplies the mesh texspace via BuildTslOptions. Unlocks the ellie paint-stroke class (x27).

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Attribute Fac output x3)
cells.notes: The Fac output of a color attribute is the component average (r+g+b)/3 — composed from the proven vertex_color and math ops over the corner-attribute proxy.

cells.failureClass: per-object attribute (the ellie paint-set frontier x30)
cells.notes: Attribute OBJECT reads an object custom property; the cell multiplies the per-object color by the UV gradient so the diff carries both. The runtime supplies the value through a per-object uniform (proven onObjectUpdate contract); the harness resolves the fixture constant via BuildTslOptions.objectAttribute.

Object Info Random scaled by the UV.x gradient - 5 of ellie's 49 visible materials (all five jacket pins) read exactly this output. Cycles derives Random as hash_uint2(hash_string(object name), 0)/0xFFFFFFFF and EEVEE computes the identical value, verified against a real render to float32 ('Cube' -> 0.313141934). The reference bake declares the TSL fixture FROM the live proxy's name via the production object_random_number helper, so the hash itself sits inside the gate - if the helper drifts from what Cycles renders, this cell fails. At runtime the value rides the proven attribute_object seam: the exporter stamps blendlink_object_random on every exported mesh object, so a material shared by several objects gets each object's own value. Named caveats: renaming an object changes the value (in Blender too), and instanced duplis use a different random_id chain the exporter does not stamp.

A muted Math between a uv.x gradient and the output. The emitter follows the node's OWN internal_links -- Blender's authoritative statement of which input each output passes through when muted -- rather than a hand table. 8 of ellie's materials carry muted Math nodes in their White Noise chains.
A muted RGBA Mix with a varying A: the bypass passes A through. Second node shape for the same mechanism, so a type-dependent internal_links surprise cannot hide behind the scalar case.

R = 3D Value, G = 2D Value, B = 3D Color's second lane (the w=1 4D hash), all over floor(uv*8) blocks. Blender hashes RAW float bits (__float_as_uint) and interpolated UVs differ between engines by ~260 ulps (measured on the uv-gradient cell), so continuous-coordinate White Noise decorrelates per texel on ANY two backends — the quantized cell gates the Jenkins port itself; continuous inputs are same-distribution but not texel-comparable.

Quantized W through the production node: gates hash_uint's 1-argument arity AND hash_float_to_vec3's Colour re-hash (lanes at vec2(k,1) and vec2(k,2), verbatim from gpu_shader_common_hash.glsl). 8 of ellie's materials use 1D/4D White Noise; the arity seed is 0xdeadbeef + (1<<2) + 13, not hashUint2(x, 0).

Quantized vector with constant W through the production node: gates hash_vec4_to_float and hash_vec4_to_vec3's swizzle triple (xyzw, zxwy, wzyx - verbatim, and verified against an independent CPU reimplementation during research: 0.7419682145 / 0.4811842442 / 0.9910845757).

DECLARED, NOT PROVEN. The corpus-maximum 1D frequency (fannypack seams at 1600; denim, shorts, shoes_loop, handkerchief between 600 and 1400 - 8 materials). The algorithm is exact and separately gated (provenBy); the divergence is the rasterizers' ~3e-5 UV sample-position difference times the frequency, measured 1.177e-2 meanAbs at scale 1600 and monotone in scale, so this figure bounds every smaller scale in the band. Bounded, not decorrelated: 1.2e-2 is thirty times short of the 0.33 a decorrelated field measures. Two-sided pinning applies - if a harness change moves this past 1.25x declared it is a regression, and below 0.5x the declaration must tighten or promote.

cells.failureClass: 2D noise, scale band 80..100 with Colour (bounded approximation)
cells.notes: DECLARED, NOT PROVEN - but only just: meanAbs 1.208e-3 misses the exact 1e-3 gate by 21% while p99 and max sit INSIDE the exact tolerances. The hair configuration (2D, detail 0.5, Colour output, scale 100), one material. The candidate for promotion to exact if the sample-position story ever improves; the inverted pinning below 0.5x declared will demand exactly that.

cells.failureClass: Smooth F1 voronoi, scale band 40..180 (bounded approximation)
cells.notes: DECLARED, NOT PROVEN. The head/head_lips/skin configuration verbatim: SMOOTH_F1, EUCLIDEAN, smoothness 1.0, randomness 1.0, Distance at 177.1. Measured meanAbs 1.719e-3 - notably better than plain F1 at the same scale (3.01e-3, measured 2026-07-30 and refused), because the smooth minimum damps the cell-boundary shifts that coordinate wiggle causes. Scoped to SMOOTH_F1 only; F1 above 40 still refuses until something needs it and earns its own cell.

cells.failureClass: white noise over continuous coordinates (declared decorrelation)
cells.notes: DECLARED, NOT PROVEN. 9 of ellie's 49 visible materials feed White Noise a raw interpolated coordinate. The hash consumes RAW float bits and the two rasterizers' interpolated UVs differ by ulps, so the Jenkins avalanche decorrelates every texel -- per-texel agreement is impossible in principle, on any two backends, and Blender does not hold its own EEVEE and Cycles to it either. The claim here is narrow and deliberately so: the PORT is exact, gated byte-for-byte by hash-probe on constant input and by white-noise over floor(uv*8) blocks, both named in provenBy and both required to pass before this cell is allowed to. What this cell adds is only that the residual divergence is confined to sample position -- same distribution, same spatial structure, different texels. Gated on mean, std, histogram L1 and radial spectrum L1, never on a loosened per-texel tolerance, and carrying an INVERTED per-texel floor so that if the error ever collapses the cell fails and demands promotion to exact instead of standing as a permanent excuse.

cells.failureClass: hash family (Voronoi F1 via the ported Jenkins hash)
cells.notes: R = 3D F1 Distance (scale 4, randomness 1, x0.6), G = 3D Color's first lane, B = 2D F1 Distance. Cell coordinates are integer-valued floats, so the hash inputs are bit-identical across engines — the 0.28 mx_worley divergence closes by porting Blender's own hash, not by finding a shared lineage. F2/smooth/other metrics/fractal detail stay named refusals.

The proven fBM on the z = 150.37 plane — the control that pins Perlin-lineage agreement in the coordinate range the noise color offsets (100..200) actually use, separating it from the offset computation.
3D fBM at scale 4, detail 4 — measuring whether the detail bound (set at <= 2 after the detail-6/scale-5 3.9e-2 divergence) can honestly extend to 4, the ellie paint-stroke class's setting (x28).

3D fBM at detail 6, scale 4 - the octave count 4 of ellie's visible materials ask for. The emitter's bound of 4 cites a detail-6/scale-5 measurement of 3.9e-2, but that figure is the same vintage as its scale-100 claim of 1.8e-1, which re-measurement put at 1.023e-3 - wrong by ~175x - so this one is worth re-measuring rather than inheriting.

3D noise, scale 5, detail 2, Distortion 1.0 - 10 of ellie's 49 visible materials. Distortion perturbs the SCALED coordinate by one signed Perlin octave per component sampled at random_floatN_offset(0..N-1); the offsets fold at emit time because they depend only on a literal seed. noisetex.h and gpu_shader_material_tex_noise.glsl were both read and agree verbatim.

cells.failureClass: noise distortion x colour-lane offset collision
cells.notes: Distortion 0.75 with the Colour output. The colour lanes use seeds 3 and 4 precisely because distortion consumes 0..2, so this cell fails if the two features are ever given overlapping offsets - the colour-lane comment records the wrong pair decorrelating at 1e-1 while Fac stays at 4e-5, which is exactly the trap.

cells.failureClass: vector rotate fixed axis + centre offset
cells.notes: Z_AXIS, centre (0.5,0.5,0), angle 0.5, rotating UV straight into the emission colour so the measurement is the vector itself rather than something downstream of it. 12 of ellie's 19 Vector Rotate nodes are Z_AXIS. Centre is at the tile middle because the reference bake refuses negative channel values.

AXIS_ANGLE with a non-unit, non-axis-aligned Axis (0.3,-0.7,0.5) and angle 0.9 - gates the normalize and all nine Rodrigues coefficients at once, including the sintheta sign asymmetry between rows. The X/Y/Z_AXIS literals ride this cell rather than needing three more, since the emitter folds them into the same op with a constant axis.

3D fBM at scale 16, detail 2 — the cell that earns the emitter's scale bound. Sub-texel sample-position differences (~3e-5 UV) multiply by frequency: scale 100 (ellie hair) measured 1.8e-1 mean decorrelation, so higher scales refuse and the Material bake carries them.

An 8x8 float Non-Color image sampled Linear/REPEAT over uv*2: manual bilinear at u*W - 0.5 with per-tap floored-modulo wrapping, no float32-filterable dependency. Pixels embed in the IR (bounded at 128x128; the texture transport carries larger images).

cells.failureClass: image cubic B-spline filter, REPEAT wrap
cells.notes: Cubic interpolation, 7 of ellie's 49 visible materials. Weights come from SET_CUBIC_SPLINE_WEIGHTS in intern/cycles/kernel/device/cpu/image.h, taps at ix-1..ix+2. three's own TextureBicubic uses the same B-spline basis term for term, but its 4-tap form leans on the hardware sampler's bilinear filter and mip chain, so it cannot be reused: every branch of the image op fetches texels explicitly to keep Blender's wrap and texel-centre semantics. REPEAT here because the outer two taps leave the tile at every edge and are precisely the ones bilinear never exercises.

cells.failureClass: image cubic B-spline filter, EXTEND clamp
cells.notes: The same filter against the EXTEND clamp, where the ix-1 and ix+2 taps saturate rather than wrap. Paired with tex-image-cubic because a wrap bug and a clamp bug look identical in the interior and differ only in the border ring.

An 8x8 BYTE sRGB image with zero-alpha texels, sampled Closest/EXTEND over uv*1.5 - 0.25. MEASURED against baked ground truth: Cycles associates alpha at load IN BYTE sRGB SPACE with integer floor division (rgb_byte*alpha_byte//255), THEN applies the exact IEC decode, and the Color output stays associated — zero alpha bakes black and nothing divides back. The emitter reproduces that byte-exact pipeline; the out-of-range sweep exercises the clamp.
3D fBM at scale 20, detail 2 — the corpus needs 18.9-20 (ellie paint chain, splash bushes); measured to extend the frequency bound honestly.

3D fBM at scale 40, detail 2 - the frequency 27 of ellie's 49 visible materials actually ask for, and the single largest TSL blocker measured on that character. Voronoi is already proven at 40 (voronoi-scale40) because integer-cell hashing only shifts local distances under coordinate wiggle; fBM octave phases amplify it instead, so noise cannot inherit that bound and has to earn its own. Scale 100 measured 1.8e-1, scale 20 passes; this cell decides whether 40 is inside tolerance or whether the material bake keeps carrying it.

3D fBM at scale 80 - the corpus asks for 50, 60 and 80, so a bound at 80 clears every 3D noise ellie has except the 2D hair at 100. Scale 40 measured 1.77e-3 maxAbs and scale 100 1.02e-3 MEAN (2.3% over its gate), with growth near-linear in frequency, so 80 is the honest place to test.

3D F1 Distance at scale 20 (x0.6): integer-cell hashing is immune to coordinate wiggle away from cell boundaries, so only the local distance shifts — measured to extend the bound to the ellie paint chain's setting.

3D F1 Distance at scale 40 (x0.6) — the deepest voronoi in the ellie paint chain. Voronoi tolerates coordinate wiggle structurally (integer-cell hashing; only local distances shift), unlike fBM noise whose octave phases amplify, so its bound is measured separately.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Image BOX projection x10)
cells.notes: Sharp box mapping (blend 0) over Object coordinates: the +Z tile normal selects the z-plane with the measured flip (Nz>0 -> u = 1-y, v = x), and the out-of-range sweep exercises REPEAT. The flat tile gates only the +Z branch; the other planes carry the same ported Cycles formula (sign flips included) as a named bound. Blend > 0 refuses.

cells.failureClass: corpus-measured node gap (Noise Color output x3)
cells.notes: 3D Noise Color (scale 4, detail 2): the second and third lanes are the SAME proven fBM at constant hash-derived offsets (noisetex.h random_float3_offset, seeds 2 and 3 — the emitter precomputes them with a CPU Jenkins). Coordinates around 100..200 keep the shared-lineage agreement.
The vec2 twin of noise-color through random_float2_offset.

R = 3D SMOOTH_F1 Distance (smoothness 1 -> params 0.5, x0.6), G = its Color lane, B = 2D Distance. The 5^d h-chain with polynomial corrections, ported verbatim; smoothness folds at emit time and zero falls back to F1 exactly like Cycles.
Magic's Fac output is the color average; the mapping also carries the upstream fmod(p*scale, 2pi) wrap Cycles applies before the cascade.

Mix Shader of two Principleds (one constant base, one UV-driven) with the factor swept past [0,1] (1.5v-0.25): emit_surface must produce mix_color with a clamped factor. The reference bakes the hand-built projection; the IR comes from the real closure graph.

Roughness 0.15 vs 0.85 lerped by a clamped out-of-range factor — the scalar-lerp composition (a + (b-a)*clamp01(fac)) from proven math ops. NOTE: parameter lerp is the documented projection model; the closure mix of BRDFs under lighting is nonlinear in these parameters and the EMIT oracle cannot measure that difference.

Mix(Principled(alpha 0.9), Transparent, fac=u): the Transparent branch contributes ONLY coverage — alpha = 0.9*(1-fac) and every other channel passes the lit branch through unweighted (lerping toward invented neutrals would corrupt them). White Transparent only; tinted refuses.

Mix(Emission(2.5x HDR), Principled(emission strength 2u)) over v: emission lerps as RADIANCE (color x strength folded first) — lerping color and strength separately is not linear in emitted light. Surface documents always ship radiance in Emission Color with Strength = 1.
Mix(Mix(P1, P2, u), P3, v): recursive per-channel folding — the ellie head/skin class (depth 4 in the corpus) exercised at depth 2.

Mix(Diffuse, Glossy, fac=u) Metallic channel: Diffuse canonicalizes to metallic 0 / roughness 1, Glossy to metallic 1, so the lerp reads back the clamped factor. The canonical channel embedding is a documented model decision.

A ColorRamp's Color output plugged straight into the Material Output Surface socket — Blender's implicit coercion treats it as emission of that color (the splash outline/sky class, 45/68 splash materials need this rule). Radiance = the color chain, strength 1.

Mix(P1, P2, fac=Fresnel IOR 1.45) under the fixed camera contract: the composed Base Color document is viewDependent and evaluates through the proven fresnel/view_cos ops — the layered-glass corpus class stays shader-side where it is exact.

cells.failureClass: captured lighting (Shader to RGB, EEVEE oracle)
cells.notes: Shader to RGB over a Diffuse BSDF with a UV-gradient albedo, coerced into the surface — the splash painterly pattern. Reference: an EEVEE ortho render under the fixed-light contract (sun straight on, strength 3, no world); TSL: albedo x diffuseIrradiance with the analytic contract value S/pi. The cell MEASURES EEVEE's diffuse response constant.

cells.failureClass: captured lighting (cosine law under the light contract)
cells.notes: Same capture with the sun tilted 60 degrees: the plateau must halve (S cos(theta) / pi), gating the Lambert cosine through a second point. The flat tile cannot vary N — the cosine is gated across cells, not across texels; production normals are Phase 4's application seam.

cells.failureClass: captured lighting (the full splash chain shape)
cells.notes: Shader to RGB -> Separate -> ColorRamp -> surface: the captured value quantized by a ramp, exactly the painterly composition. The ramp amplifies any capture-constant error, making this the sensitive gate.

Fresnel IOR 1.45 under the fixed camera contract: Cycles bakes with view_from=ACTIVE_CAMERA (rays from the camera at (0,0,2)), and the TSL side evaluates Cycles' fresnel_dielectric_cos with the analytic view cosine from the same contract. Gates the dielectric formula; the runtime view builtins are the production wiring of the same op.
Layer Weight blend 0.3 under the fixed camera contract: R = Facing (exponent-warped 1-|cos|^e), G = Fresnel (eta = 1/(1-blend)).
